subject: obstetrics-gynaecology
title: Iron and Folic Acid, Vaccination, Fundal Height and Leopold Manoeuvres

steps.tx: Daily supplementation preventing anaemia and neural tube defects combines **iron folic acid**. Folic acid ideally starts before conception and continues through the first trimester. Iron continues through pregnancy where anaemia is prevalent. Folic acid dose is 400 micrograms daily for most women, rising to 5 milligrams after a previous neural tube defect pregnancy.
steps.say: Iron folic acid prevents anaemia and neural tube defects, ideally starting before conception.

steps.tx: Tetanus and diphtheria protection in pregnancy is given as **Td vaccination**. Two doses protect mother and newborn against tetanus through transferred antibodies. Influenza and pertussis vaccines are also recommended in many programmes. Doses are spaced at least four weeks apart, and the second dose in a first pregnancy is given before delivery to maximise transfer.
steps.say: Td vaccination protects mother and newborn against tetanus through transferred antibodies.

steps.tx: Distance from pubic symphysis to uterine fundus estimating gestational age is **fundal height**. In centimetres it roughly equals weeks between twenty and thirty six. Deviations beyond three centimetres prompt ultrasound growth assessment. The fundus reaches the umbilicus at about 20 weeks and the xiphisternum near 36 weeks, two landmarks to state in examinations.
steps.say: Fundal height in centimetres roughly equals weeks and deviations prompt growth scanning.

vis.caption: Symphysio-fundal height measurement technique using tape measure from pubic symphysis to uterine fundus with gestational age landmarks. [Credit: StewardMD]

steps.tx: The four systematic palpations determining fetal position through the abdomen are the **Leopold manoeuvres**. They identify lie, presentation, position and engagement before auscultation. Ultrasound confirms when palpation is uncertain. The third manoeuvre uses one hand above the pubis to judge engagement, and the fourth faces the feet to find the presenting part.
steps.say: Leopold manoeuvres identify lie, presentation, position and engagement by palpation.

vis.caption: Medical illustration of the four Leopold manoeuvres determining fetal lie, presentation, position, and head engagement. [Credit: StewardMD]

steps.tx: Indias antenatal care day programme guaranteeing quality checkups monthly is **PMSMA**. Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan provides free specialist assessment on a fixed day each month. High risk pregnancies identified there get tracked follow up. The fixed day is the ninth of each month, and private practitioners volunteer alongside government specialists.
steps.say: PMSMA guarantees free monthly specialist antenatal assessment and high risk tracking.

steps.tx: Listening to the fetal heart after palpation completes the abdominal examination, called **auscultation**. Normal rate lies between one ten and one sixty beats per minute. Handheld Doppler is standard at antenatal visits. A rate persistently above 160 or below 110 for ten minutes needs review, not just repositioning and a repeat count.
steps.say: Auscultation after palpation confirms fetal heart rate between one ten and one sixty.

steps.tx: Anaemia screening repeats each trimester because haemoglobin falls physiologically then recovers, a pattern of **haemoglobin surveillance**. Ferritin clarifies iron deficiency when values are borderline. Intravenous iron treats late or intolerant cases. Haemoglobin under 11 grams per decilitre in the first trimester and under 10.5 in the second counts as anaemia in pregnancy.
steps.say: Haemoglobin surveillance repeats each trimester and ferritin clarifies borderline iron deficiency.

steps.tx: Counselling on danger signs requiring immediate care is part of every visit, termed **birth preparedness**. Bleeding, fits, severe headache, reduced movements and leaking fluid head the list. Transport and blood donor planning accompany it. A named blood donor and a chosen facility are written into the plan before labour, not arranged after bleeding starts.
steps.say: Birth preparedness counsels danger signs and plans transport plus blood donors.

steps.tx: Weight, oedema and blood pressure trends together flag developing **pre-eclampsia risk**. No single visit value matters as much as the trajectory. Aspirin prophylaxis for high risk women starts from twelve weeks. Low dose aspirin 150 milligrams at night from 12 weeks until delivery is the regimen most trials now support for high risk women.
steps.say: Pressure and weight trajectories flag pre-eclampsia risk better than single values.
